text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Here, I'm returning the race footage
I borrowed from you.
I casually opened the file that had been handed to me with those words.
choice_data_list: Um, 'Swamp Chihuahua: An Insane Number of Gags'

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aah! S-Sorry about that!
I brought the comedian analysis file
by mistake!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, please pretend
you didn't see what just happened..."

"A mistake like this is uncharacteristic of Lucky Lilac, who is always so meticulous.
Perhaps we should reconsider her upcoming race schedule."
